notes: Runs the shipped file. Every tool step returns its fixture under its teammate, so nothing on this Mac is read. The fixture is the shape `search_and_extract` returns: an extracted page carries its text in `markdown`, one that was not read has only its `snippet`.

results.title: Heat pumps in cold climates
results.snippet: How cold-climate heat pumps hold up in winter.
results.markdown: Cold-climate heat pumps keep most of their heating capacity down to -15 C. Field tests in Maine found a seasonal efficiency near 2.5.

results.snippet: A heat pump runs short defrost cycles in freezing, humid weather.
